popCulture.title: Diomedes
popCulture.description: Home from Troy to a shut gate — Aegialia's betrayal and the hero's Italian exile keep Diomedes among the nostoi that never quite end in peace.

popCulture.title: Aeneid
popCulture.creator: Virgil
popCulture.description: Book 11: Diomedes in Italy refuses Turnus' call to war against Aeneas — the Argive who wounded gods will not fight Venus' son again.

popCulture.title: Returns from Troy
popCulture.description: The cyclic Nostoi tradition places Diomedes among the homecomings spoiled by treachery — Argos barred, Italy opened.
